items.title: A flat finite module over a henselian local base is a filtered colimit of free modules with injective reductions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a finite flat module over an essentially finite type local map out of a henselian local ring is a filtered colimit of free modules whose transition maps induce injective maps modulo the maximal ideal, and is therefore Mittag-Leffler (statement lines 5758-5770, tag 05U7). The proof realises the module as the stalk of a finite type sheaf, arranges the associated points of the special fibre, uses the projective neighbourhood statement to get a fundamental system of affine neighbourhoods with free global sections, verifies injectivity of the reductions of the transition maps by a support argument, and applies the Mittag-Leffler criterion for colimits of universally injective maps. The support argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
